name: Mamiya Tamane
source:
What she calls the [url=/c38571]protagonist[/url]: Ryou-kun

The third daughter of the Mamiya quintuplets. She is quite motherly and the one responsible for the housework at their home. She also loves food.

At Seamore, Tamane works as the cafe's cook alongside her parents, while at the same time learning all kinds of different techniques related to cooking. Due to this, she's not part of any club or committee at the high school.

Tamane's tongue and lips are her main erogenous zones: just a kiss from her dear Ryouta can already get her turned on.
